notes: Ghana shaded cacao agroforestry: cacao under shade trees is multistrata_shade_trees (a12), out_of_scope in the vocabulary, not trees_in_farmlands (the tag was wrong). It would also fail no_outcome_data: it reports only aboveground carbon stocks (Mg C/ha) and tree diversity; REDD+ income is discussed but no payment, price, credit or revenue is given, and there are no costs, returns or adoption figures.
